cards.title: Concurrency is explicit
items: The transaction checks the versionstamp it read
A conflict retries the whole read and write, up to ten times

cards.title: One queue, in process
items: A per-id queue keeps a burst of votes from fighting itself
A second instance would still be correct, only busier

cards.title: Busy is not a lie
items: Exhausted retries answer 503 busy, and the button says so
A vote is never counted twice and never silently lost
